extension.summary: Browse and play your AIOStreams instance in Kodi
تصفّح مثيل AIOStreams الخاص بك وتشغيله داخل Kodi
extension.description: Kodi client for AIOStreams (Stremio super-addon). Paste your AIOStreams manifest URL and get your configured catalogs, metadata, sorted/filtered streams and subtitles directly in Kodi. Includes TMDbHelper player integration.
عميل Kodi لـ AIOStreams. الصق رابط ملف manifest الخاص بمثيلك لتحصل على الفهارس والبيانات الوصفية والمصادر المرتبة والمرشّحة والترجمات مباشرةً في Kodi، مع دعم مشغّلات TMDbHelper.
extension.news: v1.1.0 - Optional AIOMetadata source for catalogs, search and title details (streams still from AIOStreams); catalog source setting (AIOStreams / AIOMetadata / both); IMDb mapping for movie streams; "Show widget path" context item; menu icons (BoxIcons, as in the AIOStreams web UI) instead of the add-on icon on every entry; Play by ID (series) uses AIOMetadata with AIOStreams as fallback; Search falls back to AIOStreams when AIOMetadata has no search catalog; catalogs show the original service/source logos (Netflix, Disney+, IMDb, TMDB, Trakt, ...). v1.0.0 - Initial release, built against AIOStreams 2.37.0
